text: Are you and Leonard friends with benefits? Are you and Leonard friends with benefits?

speaker: Penny
text: What? Where did that even come from? Did he say we were?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Leonard said nothing, but who knows what goes on over here when he pretends your mail was misdelivered.

text: Just mail, no benefits. Why are you asking?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'm curious about the whole social construct. On its face, the idea of satisfying one's sexual appetite, assuming one is afflicted with such, without emotional entanglement, that seems imminently practical. What I've observed, however, is Howard Wolowitz crying like a little girl.

speaker: Penny
text: Well, some people just can't handle that kind of relationship.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Can you? Are you able to have sex with men without developing an emotional attachment?

speaker: Penny
text: Sheldon, I really don't want to talk about this with you.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Is this conversation making you uncomfortable?

speaker: Penny
text: Of course it's making me uncomfortable. Can't you tell?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I really have no idea. I don't particularly excel at reading facial expressions.
